title: Gardening
hook: 爷爷在菜园里种东西，Peppa 也想种一颗种子，还要和 George 抢着浇水。

cells.q: Where were Peppa and George playing?
cells.a: They were playing at Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's house.

cells.q: What did Peppa ask about seeds?
cells.a: She asked, “Seeds? What do seeds do?”
cells.cn: 她问：“种子？种子能做什么？”

cells.q: What will the little apple tree do?
cells.a: It will grow into a big apple tree like this one.
cells.cn: 它会长成一棵这样的大苹果树。

cells.q: What did Peppa want to do?
cells.a: She wanted to plant a seed in the garden.
cells.cn: 她想在花园里种一颗种子。

cells.q: What did George and Peppa argue about?
cells.a: They both wanted to water the seed.
cells.cn: 两个人都想给种子浇水。

cells.a: He said the seed will grow into a plant next time.
cells.cn: 他说下次来，种子就长成小苗了。

cells.a: They came back to play and see the little plant.
cells.cn: 他们又来玩，也想看看那棵小苗。

cells.a: She asked, “Can we plant something else?”
cells.cn: 她问：“我们还能种点别的吗？”

cells.q: What did Grandpa Pig ask Peppa?
cells.a: He asked, “What would you like to grow?”

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: garden, seed, plant, grow, water, apple tree
helper.actions: plant, water, grow, dig, ask, come back

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Gardening”.
ending: In the end, Grandpa Pig asks what Peppa would like to grow. My favourite part is ______.
